name: example-tool-pack
description: Reference code-tool pack (tool-distribution-granularity D-001/D-004): a runtime-less distribution unit whose only contribution is in-process tools. Two self-contained text utilities, no runtime surfaces.

tools.name: word_count
tools.description: Count words, lines, and characters in a text. Self-contained — no network, no filesystem.

tools.name: slugify
tools.description: Turn a title into a kebab-case slug (lowercase, alphanumeric + dashes). Self-contained.

maxLength.description: Truncate the slug to this many characters.
